policy: Each verdict is the qualitative judgement of one independent instance (Jira ETBZ-59 AC4), never the sole oracle for a reason code (contract section 10): the Delivery Runner corroborated every BLOCKING verdict by measuring the chart facts and claim citations it rests on, the ADVISORY codes are candidates until the Product Owner judges their quoted passages, and the contract suite checks every quote below verbatim against the accepted reading at its path. ADVISORY codes go to the Product Owner; a BLOCKING code is recorded with the smallest repair the runner can propose, and the repair itself is a separate decision (Jira ETBZ-59, out of scope).

judgements.why: the same semantic content recurs in both readings, including the chart-wide statement that the controlling family shows on no pillar's surface. No claim of either reading cites it; it holds for S; for N it is false on the family reading N's own [2.1] defines and ungrounded on any reading, so the paragraph did not respond to the named difference. Judge B: the verdict rests on that one proposition; without it the rest is shared claims plus a fixed image.

smallestRepair.fixture: confine the visibility statement to the positions the paragraph's cited facts name (in N [2.4], e.g. that the controlling voice lies hidden in the year and month branches) and drop the chart-wide negation; likewise S [2.2], [2.6], [5.1], [5.2]. A Golden run has no such repair (section 11: no reroll).
smallestRepair.skill: one hard law in SKILL.md section 1: a paragraph states nothing about chart positions its cited facts do not name - no absence from, presence in all of, or restriction to positions (keine, jede, nur, überall, nirgends over pillars, branches, stems or their surface) - with a boundary triage that names such quantifiers for the one repair. A Skill change needs a new released Skill identity and bundle binding: a Product Owner decision outside ETBZ-59.
